name: 色调映射分析
algorithm: Tone Mapping Analysis — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes tone mapping characteristics for image forensic analysis:

1. **ToneCurve估计**: The effective tone curve (mapping from scene luminance to pixel values) is estimated from the image content. This is done by analyzing: highlight rolloff behavior, shadow detail rendering, and the overall luminance distribution relative to expected scene statistics.

2. **Tone映射Operator检测**: Different cameras and processing pipelines apply different tone mapping operators (TMOs). The method identifies the TMO type — standard curves (sRGB gamma), camera-specific tone curves (S-curves), HDR tone mapping (Reinhard, Drago, Mantiuk), or AI-generated tone mapping. AI generators learn tone mapping from their training data and may produce inconsistent or unusual tone curves.

3. **Per-区域ToneResponse分析**: The local tone response is analyzed in different image regions. In single-capture images, the same tone curve applies globally. Composite images may show different effective tone curves in different regions — a key indicator of manipulation.

4. **DynamicRange一致性**: The effective dynamic range and its distribution across the image are analyzed. Natural single-capture images have consistent dynamic range limited by the sensor. AI-generated images may show dynamic range inconsistencies — regions with impossible dynamic range extension or unnatural highlight-shadow balance.

5. **Tone映射ForensicScore**: Tone mapping features (estimated TMO parameters, per-region tone response consistency, dynamic range analysis) are combined into a forensic score. The score captures tone mapping inconsistencies indicative of compositing, AI generation, or post-processing manipulation.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： tone mapping analysis 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Reinhard, E. et al. (2001). Color Transfer Between Images. IEEE CG&A.
Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
